title: LotKeys Info
summary: V0.9.5.50 brings the reviewed web reliability and Inventory media updates to the regular site.

blocks.text: Includes cached sign-in recovery, Inventory photo refresh/retry, retained upload checkpoints, preparation screen wake and compact Account controls. Google may request the approved app-specific pairing-data permission. Regular-user locked-screen/background request finalization and the reported paired-PC send issue remain unverified; the original Android connector and live Store processors are unchanged. Compare remains manual/import only, with no connected automatic listing search.
